say:2:1224501001:1.text: Lucca, have you guys chosen the navigator for the advance fleet?

say:3:1224501002:1.text: Not yet. Bella's still not down for it.

say:4:1224501003:1.text: But no one else is a better fit than her.

say:8:1224501005:1.text: Bella grew up in Brineville. She took after her father, an exceptional sailor, and is good at sailing and navigating ships.

say:9:1224501006:1.text: Plus, Bella follows our instructions really well. Since she joined us, she's never gone against Sonja or me. That's why I promoted her to her current position.
say:9:1224501006:1.source_cn: 而且，贝拉很听话。自打她加入血薇帮，从来没有违抗过索尼...

say:10:1224501007:1.text: This is her first time saying no to a task, and she's firm about it. I don't get it.
say:10:1224501007:1.source_cn: 这是她第一次拒绝任务，非常坚决。我想不明白。
